description: Frozen independent source-labelled fictional harbour-service operations corpus. Not real-session evidence. Written before any raw ranking inspection or candidate calibration. Calibration split is distinct; holdout never tunes acceptance.
facts: uploads.recovery
Uploads interrupted by a network disconnect resume from the last acknowledged chunk rather than starting again.
invoices.delivery
Les factures finalisées sont envoyées en pièce jointe au contact comptable chaque vendredi.
search.privacy
Search results hide personal email addresses from visitors who are not signed in.
jobs.retry
Failed background jobs retry three times with exponentially increasing delays, then enter a dead-letter queue.
maintenance.owner
Maya approves planned downtime; engineers cannot schedule an outage without her written consent.
exports.encoding
Les exports CSV utilisent UTF-8 avec un indicateur BOM pour éviter les accents corrompus dans Excel.
webhooks.delivery
Webhook deliveries include a unique event identifier; recipients must deduplicate repeated deliveries.
mobile.offline
The mobile app keeps saved inspection forms locally when connectivity is unavailable and synchronizes them after reconnection.
deletion.grace
After an account deletion request, data remains recoverable for fourteen days before permanent erasure.
access.temporary
Les accès des prestataires expirent automatiquement à la fin de leur mission; aucun compte permanent n'est créé.
alerts.routing
Urgent overnight alarms page the on-call engineer, not the daytime customer-service team.
images.validation
Image attachments are decoded and checked for excessive pixel dimensions before storage to prevent decompression bombs.
